description: A Ghostly identity proof: the account authorizes one Ghostly proof key to present this account to contacts the person chooses, for a period. See https://github.com/MiguelMedeiros/ghostly/blob/dev/docs/wisps/3xx-atproto.md.

main.description: The record key is the proof key the statement authorizes (52 characters of z-base-32), so the record is found and deleted by that key.

statement.description: The Ghostly identity statement, exactly as built by identityStatement() (one line, no trailing newline). Its subject is this account's DID.
